pinned_source.applied_inequality: for every physical cross block M of a slab witness ratio rho, e_5(M^T M)<=(5 sqrt(2e)/rho)^10 and s_5(M)<=5 sqrt(2e)/rho

key_facts: Partner r41 gives at most ten named physical centers and two rowwise projective strips of widths rho^-1/6 and 24.540 rho^-1/6 in the hard diffuse exact-rank-two chamber.
Conditioning the finite centers in original coordinates preserves the remaining product law and loses no slab ratio, but produces arbitrary affine terms.
If outside C union supp(D) the latent rows occupy at most m exact lines and N=|C union supp(D)|+m, grouping before curvature gives ||p||_infty<=250 e N(8+log N).
For the exact r41 two-line endpoint with diagonal curvature confined to the at-most-ten centers, N<=12 and ||p||_infty<85503.
Rowwise strip width does not imply aggregate-small residual: balanced rows m^-1/2(1,+/-1) are all m^-1/2 from one line but the projected residual has Frobenius and operator norm one.
The optimizer-free finite-mixture reduction remains the only valid extremal-product transfer; no centered interval, bounded diameter, fixed fragment count, or attained global optimizer.
